ShortDescription: Provides Active Directory authentication, authorization, domain controller replication, and LDAP services.
Resolves hostnames to IP addresses and supports Active Directory service discovery.
Automatically assigns IP addresses and network settings to clients.
Provides a unified namespace for distributed file shares.
Replicates files and folders between servers and domain controllers.
Authenticates users and computers against domain controllers and maintains secure channels.
Issues Kerberos authentication tickets for Active Directory.
Synchronizes system clocks with domain or external time sources.
Provides Windows file sharing, printer sharing, and named pipe communication.
Manages print queues and printer communications.
Provides Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate issuance services.
Handles inter-process communication used by many Windows services.
Collects and stores operating system and application events.
Enables remote Windows administration using PowerShell and management tools.
Supports Windows Failover Clustering and high availability.
Replicates virtual machines between Hyper-V hosts.
Migrates running virtual machines between Hyper-V hosts.
Sends and relays email messages.
Allows email clients to retrieve messages from a mail server.
Enables monitoring and management by network management systems.
Sends SNMP event notifications to monitoring systems.
Hosts websites and web applications.
Hosts FTP sites and facilitates file transfers.
Provides reliable message delivery for distributed applications.
Provides VPN, NAT, and routing functionality.
Provides legacy NetBIOS name resolution services.
Provides remote desktop connectivity to Windows servers and workstations.
